title.narrative: Rapid Assessment of Data Gaps for Green Transition and SDG Monitoring in Vietnam

description.narrative: The activity supports Vietnam’s ability to measure, manage, and implement national development priorities focused on climate change, sustainability, and inclusive economic growth. It directly contributes to strengthening statistical capacity in a lower-middle-income country, enabling evidence-based policymaking and improved monitoring of SDG and climate-related targets.

To conduct a focused mapping and prioritisation of critical data gaps relevant to Vietnam’s green transition. The assignment will analyse the availability and limitations of statistical data needed to monitor progress on the SDGs related to the green transition, the SEEA (System of Environmental Economic Accounting) framework, and the National Green Growth Strategy. Based on this analysis, the consultant will deliver practical recommendations for improving the coherence and readiness of Vietnam’s statistical system to support future sustainability policy and programming.
